title: ULIP, endowment and money-back policies vs term plus mutual fund
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: ULIPs, endowment and money-back policies bundle insurance with investment. They typically offer low life cover for the premium, have charges (allocation, mortality, admin) that eat into early-year returns, and lock your money for years, with surrender penalties. In many cases, buying a pure term plan for protection and investing the difference in a low-cost mutual fund or PPF gives higher cover and often higher long-term returns, with more flexibility. ULIPs are not always bad — a long-term ULIP with low charges can be reasonable for some people, and recent ULIP gains above premium thresholds are taxed — but agents often push them because of commissions, so ask for the total charges, the actual life cover and the surrender value in year 1, 3 and 5 in writing before buying.
summary_hinglish: ULIP, endowment aur money-back policies insurance aur investment ko mix karti hain, par cover kam, charges zyada aur paisa kai saal lock. Aksar pure term plan + low-cost mutual fund/PPF zyada cover aur behtar returns deta hai. Kharidne se pehle total charges, asli cover aur surrender value likhit mein maango.
summary_hi: ULIP, एंडोवमेंट और मनी-बैक पॉलिसी बीमा और निवेश को मिलाती हैं, पर कवर कम, चार्ज ज़्यादा और पैसा कई साल बंद। अक्सर शुद्ध टर्म प्लान + कम लागत वाला म्यूचुअल फंड/PPF ज़्यादा कवर और बेहतर रिटर्न देता है। खरीदने से पहले कुल चार्ज, असली कवर और सरेंडर वैल्यू लिखित में मांगें।
